simple.meaning: to do or make , in the broadest sense and widest application
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עָשָׂה (H6213) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2640 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עָשָׂה (ʻâsâh) means to do or make , in the broadest sense and widest application First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 10.

definitions.full: H6213. asah I. עָשָׂה 2622 verb do, make (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; MI 23, 26 עשתי , l. 3 ; l. 9 ואעש , l. 24 Imperative עשו ; Old Hebrew proper name מעשיהו אלעשה, עשיו, ; not Aramaic, and not certainly found in South Semitic languages; on Sabean see especially DHM SB Berl. Akkadian 1886, 849 ); — Qal 2524 Perfect 3masculine singular Gen 3:1 +, suffix עָשָׂהוּ Hosea 8:6 +; 3 feminine singular עָֽשְׂתָה Deut 22:21 +, וְעָשָׂת consecutive Lev 25:21 ; 2 masculine singular עָשִׂיתָ Gen 3:14 +, etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יַעֲשֶׂה 18:25 +, וַיַּעֲשֶׂה 1Kin 16:25 3 t., וַיַּעַשׂ Isa 5:2 +; יַעֲשֵׂה 64:3 , 2 masculine singular תַּעֲשֶׂה 1Sam 10:8 , תַּעֲשֵׂה Gen 26:29 ; Josh 7:9 , jussive (with אַל ) תַּעַשׂ Gen 22:12 +, תַּעֲשֵׂה 2Sam 13:12 ; Jer 40:16 Qr (Kt תַּעַשׂ ); 1 singular אֶעֱשֶׂה Gen 2:18 +, וָאֶעֱשֶׂה Ezek 20:14 ; Dan 8:27 , וָאַעַשׂ Deut 10:3-4 t. Ezekiel; etc.; Imperative masculine singular עֲשֵׂה Judg 10:15 +; feminine singular עֲשִׂי Jer 6:26 +, etc.; Infinitive absolute עָשׂה 44:17 +; עָשׂוֺ 7:5 2 t. ( 4:18 van d. H. עָשׂוּ ); construct עֲשׂוֺת Gen 2:4 +, עֲשׂה 50:20 2 t., עֲשׂוֺ 31:28 , suffix עֲשׂתוֺ 41:32 +, עֲשׂהוּ Exod 18:18 , etc.; Participle active עשֶֹׁה Isa 5:5 +, suffix הָעשֹׁוֺ Job 40:19 (but see below); plural עשִֹׁים Gen 24:49 +; suffix עשָֹׁ֑י Job 35:10 (yet see Ges § 124k ), etc.; passive עָשׂוּי Exod 3:16 +, הֶעָשׂוּ Job 41:25 (Ges § 75k ); feminine עֲשׂוּיָה Ezek 21:20 +, etc.; — I. 1. do (1560 + t.): a. (1) with accusative active Gen 3:14 (J) 20:10 (E) + often; do right in eyes of ׳י 2Kin 12:3 ; 14:13 +, evil 8:18 , 27 + (compare I. עַיִן 3c ); do God's commands, statutes, etc., Deut 16:12 ; 30:8 ; Num 15:39 (P); ׳ע חַיִל 1Sam 14:48 + do might , i.e. mightily, valiantly; Proverbs 31:39 do efficiency , i.e. efficiently; = commit (offence) Lev 20:13 (H), Deut 20:18 ; followed by מִן particle, מֵהֵנָּה מֵאַחַת וְעָשָׂה Lev 4:2 and shall do a single one of them (things prohibited; see מִן 3b ( d )), compare י מִכָּלמִֿצְוֺת אַחַת ׳וְעָשׂוּ 4:13 ; 4:22 ; 5:17 (all P); do = perform a work, with accusative of congnate meaning with verb מַעֲשֶׂה Exod 18:20 ; 23:12 (E), also ( ׳י subject) Deut 11:7 ; Dan 9:14 ; Eccl 3:11 ; with accusative מְלָאכָה Gen 2:2 (twice in verse) (J), Exod 20:9-10 , = Deut 9:13 (10 Words); with accusative דְּרָכֶיךָ Isa 58:13 ; ׳ע עַל מְלוּכָה 1Kin 21:7 = exercise sovereignty over ; of ׳י performing signs ( אֹתֹת ) Josh 24:17 (E), Num 14:11 , 22 (JE), Deut 11:3 , so Moses Exod 4:17 and ( מֹפְתִים ) 4:21 . (2) do something to one ( ל person) Gen 20:9 (E), Judg 9:56 +; with עַל reflexive Jer 26:19 do evil against ourselves ; especially ׳י subject, with לְ , do good to Exod 18:9 (E), 2 Kings 8:66, or evil Gen 42:28 (E); in phrase so may God do to me , etc. 1Sam 3:17 ; 2Kin 6:31 + (see יסף Hiph`il 1. ). (3) do something for one ( ל person) Gen 30:31 ; 1Kin 11:8 +, direct object omitted 1Sam 20:4 ; + ל of thing Judg 21:7 , 16 what shall we do for them, for wives ? with עַל person Neh 5:19 ; with dativus ethicus [dative of interest] ( ל ) 1Sam 10:7 ; with לְ , of ׳י doing kindness for 22:3 ; executing vengeance for Judg 11:36 (+ מִן of enemy); ׳י doing a sign ( אוֺת ) for 6:17 (elsewhere לְ אוֺת נָתַן ), compare לְטוֺבָה אוֺת עֲשֵׂהעִֿמִּי Psa 86:17 . (4) do something (in relation or intercourse) wilth ( אֵת person), ׳י subject Deut 1:30 all that he did with you , 10:21 (compare Psa 86:17 above), human subject 2Chr 24:24 (object שְׁפָטִים ), Ruth 2:11 . (5) seldom with ב , usually of executing judgment upon 1Sam 28:18 ; Isa 48:14 , more Generally Est 1:15 what shall we do with the queen ? also, subject ׳י , Ezek 25:11 ; 28:26 ; Psa 149:7 ; 149:9 ; Num 33:4 (on false gods); in good sense, ׳ע בּ ׳חֲסָדִים Neh 13:14 . (6) of ׳י doing the justice ( מִשְׁמַּט ) of any one, i.e. maintaining his cause 1Kin 8:45 , 49 ; Psa 9:5 . (7) with adverb do thus , כֹּה , Josh 6:14 (JE), according to , כְּ Gen 6:22 (P), 18:21 (J), 1Kin 2:6 ; accusative as , כַּאֲשֶׁר Gen 27:19 (J); Exod 1:17 (E) +; with בְּ of manner, Judg 9:16 a, Ezek 8:18 ; 25:15 . b. work for ( ל of thing) Gen 30:30 (J); with ל person 1Sam 14:6 ; Ezek 29:20 (for ׳י ); work in ( ב ) gold or other material 1Kin 7:14 ; 2Chr 2:6 ; 2:13 ; Exod 31:4-5 , 35:32 (all P); with בָּהּ (i.e. בָּעֲבֹדָה ) 5:9 (J) in toil; work with ( עִם ) God 1Sam 14:45 , so probably of God's working with ( אֵת ) Moses and Aaron 12:6 (usually appoint ); with אֵת with (of person in whose company, in whose field Ruth 2:19 (twice in verse) (gleaning); work כַּמֶּיהָ בְּחֵפֶץ Prov 31:13 ; without preposition Exod 36:1 ; Neh 3:28 . 2 deal with, with עִם , 2Chr 2:2 ; Dan 1:13 ( כַּאֲשֶׁר accusative as ); with אֵת , Ezek 20:44 ; Psa 109:21 ; Ezek 22:14 ; Zeph 3:19 (perhaps; Gr Now insert כָּלָה , see II 1 g ), + כְּ Jer 21:2 , + בְּ of manner Ezek 23:25 , 29 ; with לְ person + בְּ 25:12 ; with בְּ person, Jer 18:23 ; Dan 11:7 , + כְּ according to Neh 9:24 ; Est 3:11 . 3 often in phrase, do kindness ( חֶסֶד ) with: with עִם (עִמָּדִ) Gen 19:19 ; 24:12 ; 12:14 (J), Judg 1:24 ; 8:35 ; 1Sam 15:6 ; 2Sam 2:5 ; 10:2 = 1Chr 19:2 +; with עַל , 1Sam 20:8 (but read עִם Vrss We Dr and others); absolute, Psa 109:16 ; object חֶסֶד + אֱמֶת , with עִם , Josh 2:14 (JE) Judg 9:19 ; 2Sam 2:6 ; with אֵת with , Gen 24:49 ; 32:11 ; 47:29 (all J); with לְ , Exod 20:6 = Deut 5:10 ; 2Sam 22:51 = Psalm 18:51; so ׳ע טוֺב , with עִם , Gen 26:29 (J), compare Judg 8:35 ; 9:16 ; with אֵת with , 1Sam 24:19 ; 2Sam 2:6 . 4 absolute act, act with effect , especially of ׳י , 1Kin 8:32 , 39 ; Jer 14:7 ; Ezek 20:9 , 14 , 22 ; Psalm 22:32; Psa 37:5 ; Psalm 52:11; Dan 9:19 ; of men 2Chr 31:21 ; Dan 8:12 , 24 ; 11:28 , 30 , 32 ; with ל of person Ezek 31:11 . II. 1. make (670 + t.): a. with object concrete, ark Gen 8:6 , altar 13:4 , idols Judg 18:24 , 31 +, etc. b. often of God's making (creating) Gen 3:1 (J), 1:7 , 16 , 25 (P), Neh 9:6 ; Job 9:9 ; Prov 8:26 ; 2Chr 2:11 ; Psa 95:5 +; making man 100:3 ; 119:73 (made by God's hands), in the womb Job 31:15 (twice in verse); making, constituting, nation Deut 26:19 ; 32:6 , 15 ; participle suffix עשֵֹׁהוּ his Maker Isa 17:7 ; Prov 14:31 ; 17:5 ( הָעשֹׁוֺ Job 40:19 is improbable, most read הֶעָשָׂוּי , with various interpretation of following words); עשֶֹׁךָ Isa 51:13 , עשֵֹׁנִי Job 32:23 (Ginsb; Job 32:22 van d. H. Baer), עשֵֹׁנוּ Psa 95:6 ; so apparently plural participle עשָֹׁ֑י Job 35:10 , עשַֹׁיִךְ Isa 54:5 (Ges § 124k explanation as sg.). c. make something, with לְ reflexive, make for thee Exod 20:4 ; Deut 9:12 ; 10:1 +, for ( ל ) another 1Sam 2:19 ; 2Sam 7:11 ; 1Kin 2:24 +; object מִשְׁתֶּה banquet Gen 40:20 ; Est 5:4 , also (no ל ) Gen 29:22 (E) Judg 14:10 ; Est 5:5 , 12 and (figurative, ׳י subject) Isa 25:6 ; with ל of thing, Deut 22:8 ; with ל of animal Gen 33:17 (J). d. make a name ( שֵׁם ) for oneself ( ל ) 2Sam 7:9 ; 1Chr 17:8 , also (no ל ) 2Sam 8:13 ; a new heart for oneself ( ל ) Ezek 18:31 . e. make war with ( אֶת ) Gen 14:2 ; Josh 11:18 (D); with עִם , Deut 20:12 , 20 ; 1Chr 5:10 , 19 ; absolute 22:8 ; with ל reflexive Prov 24:6 ; participle מִלְחָמָה עשֵֹׁה 2Chr 11:1 ; 26:11 , 13 ; make peace, with ל person Josh 9:15 (J); ׳ע בְרָכָה אִתִּי 2Kin 18:31 make an agreement with me . f. with ׳ע בּ ׳מֶּרֶץ ב, Judg 21:15 ׳י brought a catastrophe upon (compare פרץ ). g. with 2 accusative, make something out of (accusative mater.)
